bio: Indulge in a luxurious Afternoon Tea at St. Michaels Resort, a relaxing hotel and spa in the heart of Cornwall.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Garden Kitchen, a light and airy restaurant overlooking the peaceful Falmouth Bay.  Enjoy a selection of fresh seasonal sandwiches, hand-made buttermilk scones served with Cornish clotted cream, local jam and an array of decadent desserts.
